sql: SELECT i.id,i.product_id,i.location_id,i.purchase_id,p.purchased,i.qty FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id=p.id ORDER BY i.product_id,p.purchased,i.qty,i.id
SELECT l.id,l.order_id,l.product_id,l.qty,o.ordered,o.delivery FROM orderlines l JOIN orders o ON l.order_id=o.id ORDER BY l.product_id,o.ordered,o.id,l.id

WITH inv AS (SELECT i.*,p.purchased,SUM(i.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased,i.qty,i.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)-i.qty lo,SUM(i.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased,i.qty,i.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) hi FROM inventory i JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id=p.id WHERE i.qty>0), dem AS (SELECT l.*,o.ordered,SUM(l.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered,o.id,l.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)-l.qty lo,SUM(l.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered,o.id,l.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) hi FROM orderlines l JOIN orders o ON l.order_id=o.id WHERE l.qty>0), picks AS (SELECT d.product_id,d.id line_id,d.order_id,d.qty demand_qty,i.id inventory_id,i.location_id,i.qty inventory_qty,MIN(d.hi,i.hi)-MAX(d.lo,i.lo) picked FROM dem d JOIN inv i ON d.product_id=i.product_id AND d.lo<i.hi AND i.lo<d.hi) SELECT * FROM picks ORDER BY product_id,line_id,inventory_id

WITH inv AS (SELECT i.*,p.purchased,SUM(i.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased,i.qty,i.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)-i.qty lo,SUM(i.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased,i.qty,i.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) hi FROM inventory i JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id=p.id WHERE i.qty>0), dem AS (SELECT l.*,o.ordered,SUM(l.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered,o.id,l.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)-l.qty lo,SUM(l.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered,o.id,l.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) hi FROM orderlines l JOIN orders o ON l.order_id=o.id WHERE l.qty>0), picks AS (SELECT d.product_id,d.id line_id,d.order_id,d.qty demand_qty,i.id inventory_id,i.location_id,i.qty inventory_qty,MIN(d.hi,i.hi)-MAX(d.lo,i.lo) picked FROM dem d JOIN inv i ON d.product_id=i.product_id AND d.lo<i.hi AND i.lo<d.hi) SELECT p.product_id,SUM(p.picked) total_picked,(SELECT SUM(qty) FROM inv i WHERE i.product_id=p.product_id) available,(SELECT SUM(qty) FROM dem d WHERE d.product_id=p.product_id) required,MAX(p.picked>p.demand_qty OR p.picked>p.inventory_qty) over_single FROM picks p GROUP BY p.product_id

WITH inv AS (SELECT i.*,p.purchased,SUM(i.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased,i.qty,i.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)-i.qty lo,SUM(i.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased,i.qty,i.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) hi FROM inventory i JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id=p.id WHERE i.qty>0), dem AS (SELECT l.*,o.ordered,SUM(l.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered,o.id,l.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)-l.qty lo,SUM(l.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered,o.id,l.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) hi FROM orderlines l JOIN orders o ON l.order_id=o.id WHERE l.qty>0), picks AS (SELECT d.product_id,d.id line_id,d.order_id,d.qty demand_qty,i.id inventory_id,i.location_id,i.qty inventory_qty,MIN(d.hi,i.hi)-MAX(d.lo,i.lo) picked FROM dem d JOIN inv i ON d.product_id=i.product_id AND d.lo<i.hi AND i.lo<d.hi) SELECT p.name,COUNT(*) allocations,AVG(100.0*picked/inventory_qty) inventory_pct,AVG(100.0*picked/demand_qty) demand_pct FROM picks x JOIN products p ON x.product_id=p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY p.name

WITH inv AS (SELECT i.*,p.purchased,SUM(i.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased,i.qty,i.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)-i.qty lo,SUM(i.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased,i.qty,i.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) hi FROM inventory i JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id=p.id WHERE i.qty>0), dem AS (SELECT l.*,o.ordered,SUM(l.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered,o.id,l.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)-l.qty lo,SUM(l.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered,o.id,l.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) hi FROM orderlines l JOIN orders o ON l.order_id=o.id WHERE l.qty>0), picks AS (SELECT d.product_id,d.id line_id,d.order_id,d.qty demand_qty,i.id inventory_id,i.location_id,i.qty inventory_qty,MIN(d.hi,i.hi)-MAX(d.lo,i.lo) picked FROM dem d JOIN inv i ON d.product_id=i.product_id AND d.lo<i.hi AND i.lo<d.hi) SELECT p.name AS product_name,AVG(100.0*x.picked/x.inventory_qty) AS average_pick_percentage FROM picks x JOIN products p ON x.product_id=p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY p.name

WITH inv AS (SELECT i.*,p.purchased,SUM(i.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased,i.qty,i.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)-i.qty lo,SUM(i.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased,i.qty,i.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) hi FROM inventory i JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id=p.id WHERE i.qty>0), dem AS (SELECT l.*,o.ordered,SUM(l.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered,o.id,l.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)-l.qty lo,SUM(l.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered,o.id,l.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) hi FROM orderlines l JOIN orders o ON l.order_id=o.id WHERE l.qty>0), picks AS (SELECT d.product_id,d.id line_id,d.order_id,d.qty demand_qty,i.id inventory_id,i.location_id,i.qty inventory_qty,MIN(d.hi,i.hi)-MAX(d.lo,i.lo) picked FROM dem d JOIN inv i ON d.product_id=i.product_id AND d.lo<i.hi AND i.lo<d.hi) SELECT p.name,COUNT(*) allocations,COUNT(DISTINCT x.inventory_id) touched_inventory,AVG(100.0*x.picked/t.allocated_qty) normalized_allocated_pct FROM picks x JOIN (SELECT inventory_id,SUM(picked) allocated_qty FROM picks GROUP BY inventory_id) t ON x.inventory_id=t.inventory_id JOIN products p ON x.product_id=p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY p.name

WITH inv AS (SELECT i.*,p.purchased,SUM(i.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased,i.qty,i.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)-i.qty lo,SUM(i.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased,i.qty,i.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) hi FROM inventory i JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id=p.id WHERE i.qty>0), dem AS (SELECT l.*,o.ordered,SUM(l.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered,o.id,l.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)-l.qty lo,SUM(l.qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered,o.id,l.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) hi FROM orderlines l JOIN orders o ON l.order_id=o.id WHERE l.qty>0), picks AS (SELECT d.product_id,d.id line_id,d.order_id,d.qty demand_qty,i.id inventory_id,i.location_id,i.qty inventory_qty,MIN(d.hi,i.hi)-MAX(d.lo,i.lo) picked FROM dem d JOIN inv i ON d.product_id=i.product_id AND d.lo<i.hi AND i.lo<d.hi) SELECT p.name,x.inventory_id,x.inventory_qty,SUM(picked) allocated_qty,SUM(picked)<x.inventory_qty partial FROM picks x JOIN products p ON x.product_id=p.id GROUP BY p.name,x.inventory_id ORDER BY p.name,x.inventory_id
SELECT p.name,l.order_id,l.location_id,l.qty FROM picking_line l JOIN products p ON l.product_id=p.id ORDER BY p.name,l.order_id,l.location_id

WITH inv AS (SELECT i.product_id, i.qty, pu.purchased, i.id, SUM(i.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY pu.purchased ASC, i.qty ASC, i.id ASC) AS cum FROM inventory i JOIN purchases pu ON pu.id = i.purchase_id), tot AS (SELECT product_id, MAX(cum) AS total FROM inv GROUP BY product_id), dem AS (SELECT ol.id, ol.product_id, ol.qty, COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered ASC, o.id ASC, ol.id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0) AS prev FROM orderlines ol JOIN orders o ON o.id = ol.order_id) SELECT p.name AS product_name, AVG(MIN(d.qty, MAX(0, t.total - d.prev)) * 100.0 / d.qty) AS average_pick_percentage FROM dem d JOIN products p ON p.id = d.product_id JOIN tot t ON t.product_id = d.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY p.name;
